text:
You need someone who can keep SEO content accurate, engaging, and optimized while also using AI editing tools to improve performance.

I’m Noor Halden, with 6 years of experience in Python and machine learning, and I can bring a structured, detail-focused approach to your content workflow. In a telecom churn prediction project, I built a monthly churn score for 380k subscribers with per-customer SHAP reasons the retention team could read, reaching AUC 0.84 on a held-out quarter. In a contract clause search assistant, I built a system that answers questions over 9,000 contracts and always quotes the clause and page it used, with faithfulness of 0.91 on a 120-question lawyer-written test set.

I’d be glad to help with SEO strategy, content editing, AI-assisted optimization, and performance tracking.
